en.title: Verifying Registration Payments
en.excerpt: Learn how organizers review participant payment proofs, verify bank transfers or gateway transactions, approve tournament slots, and manage payment statuses.
en.content:
When archers or club managers register for a tournament, their registrations remain in a Pending Payment status until their transaction is verified and approved. Panitia/organizers can monitor and validate all inbound registration fees through the Payments & Transactions module.

1. Overview of Payment Verification

Archeris supports two primary payment workflows:

  • Direct Manual Transfer: Participants upload payment receipts (slip transfer bank, QRIS screenshot). Organizers review the receipt image and mark the transaction as paid.
  • Automated Payment Gateway: In supported regions, payments made via online gateways (Midtrans, PayPal, Virtual Account) are verified and confirmed automatically via instant webhooks.

2. Manual Bank Transfer Verification

To inspect and confirm manual bank transfer submissions:

  1. Go to Organizer Dashboard > Tournaments > Select Event > Payments.
  2. Filter the transaction list by Status: Pending Verification.
  3. Click on any transaction row to view the transaction details modal.
  4. Inspect the uploaded receipt image, bank reference number, transfer timestamp, and nominal amount against your bank account statement.

3. Automatic Gateway Verification

For automated gateway transactions, the status updates in real time to Paid / Completed as soon as the participant completes checkout. The system automatically releases the participant's official tournament bib number and assigns their category quota slot.

4. Approving or Rejecting Transactions

When reviewing a pending manual payment:

  • Approve (Confirm Payment): Click Approve Payment. The transaction status switches to Paid, the participant's registration is confirmed, and a confirmation email is dispatched with the tournament entry voucher.
  • Reject (Invalid Receipt / Nominal Mismatch): Click Reject Payment. Enter a brief explanation for the participant (e.g., "Transfer amount did not match registration fee, please re-upload valid proof"). The participant can re-upload a corrected receipt from their portal.

5. Bulk Payment Reconciliation

Organizers managing large multi-category championships can export payment reports into Excel (XLSX) or CSV format for bookkeeping and financial audits. The export includes transaction UUIDs, archer names, club affiliations, registered categories, amounts paid, and approval timestamps.

id.title: Verifikasi Pembayaran Pendaftaran
id.excerpt: Pelajari cara panitia memeriksa bukti transfer peserta, memvalidasi transaksi gateway, mengonfirmasi slot pendaftaran atlet, dan mengelola status pembayaran.
id.content:
Ketika pemanah atau manajer klub mendaftar ke turnamen, status pendaftaran mereka berstatus Menunggu Pembayaran (Pending) hingga bukti transfer atau transaksi diverifikasi oleh panitia. Panitia dapat memantau dan memvalidasi seluruh biaya pendaftaran melalui menu Pembayaran & Transaksi.

1. Gambaran Umum Verifikasi Pembayaran

Sistem Archeris mendukung dua mekanisme alur pembayaran:

  • Transfer Manual Rekening Panitia: Peserta mengunggah foto bukti transfer bank atau struk QRIS. Panitia memeriksa kesesuaian mutasi rekening dan memvalidasi pembayaran secara manual.
  • Payment Gateway Otomatis: Untuk metode pembayaran digital (Virtual Account, E-Wallet, Kartu Kredit), sistem memverifikasi transaksi secara otomatis via *webhook real-time* seketika pembayaran berhasil.

2. Verifikasi Transfer Bank Manual

Tahapan memeriksa dan mengonfirmasi bukti transfer manual:

  1. Buka menu Dashboard Organizer > Turnamen > Pilih Event > Pembayaran (Payments).
  2. Gunakan filter status Menunggu Verifikasi (Pending).
  3. Klik baris transaksi untuk membuka modal rincian pembayaran.
  4. Periksa gambar bukti transfer, nomor referensi bank, waktu transfer, dan jumlah nominal pembayaran dengan mutasi rekening resmi turnamen.

3. Verifikasi Gateway Otomatis

Pada transaksi via payment gateway otomatis, status pembayaran langsung berubah menjadi Lunas (Paid) tanpa memerlukan verifikasi manual panitia. Sistem secara otomatis mengamankan kuota kategori lomba dan menerbitkan nomor peserta.

4. Menyetujui atau Menolak Transaksi

Saat memproses pembayaran manual:

  • Setujui (Konfirmasi Pembayaran): Klik tombol Setujui Pembayaran. Status transaksi berubah menjadi Lunas, slot peserta terkonfirmasi aktif, dan email konfirmasi otomatis dikirimkan ke peserta.
  • Tolak (Bukti Tidak Valid / Nominal Kurang): Klik Tolak Pembayaran dan cantumkan alasan penolakan (contoh: "Nominal transfer kurang dari total tagihan, silakan unggah ulang bukti yang sesuai"). Peserta dapat mengunggah ulang bukti pembayaran yang benar melalui akun mereka.

5. Rekonsiliasi Pembayaran Massal

Untuk turnamen berskala besar dengan ratusan peserta, panitia dapat mengekspor rekapitulasi data pembayaran ke dalam format Excel (XLSX) atau CSV untuk mempermudah audit pembukuan keuangan dan rekonsiliasi kas panitia.
